about: Free tiers and plans for compute, CI and AI inference, public fields only. Built by tools/catalog.py; every row names the vendor page it was read on and the date. verified: true means every figure was read on that first-party page on that date; false means it was not re-read since.

rows.name: Bitrise Build Hub Basic Tier 1 (GitHub Actions runners)
rows.price_note: $20 per month billed monthly, or $18 per month billed annually.
rows.includes: Managed GitHub Actions runners: 480 included minutes per month per OS (8 hours macOS and 8 hours Linux), macOS M2 Pro Large (6 vCPU, 14 GB), Linux up to Medium (4 vCPU, 16 GB), 1 concurrent VM.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Pay-As-You-Go, if switched on, runs at 2x the standard per-minute rate with a user-set cap from $5. Page lists monthly caps of $99 (macOS) and $39 (Linux) for Tier 1 VMs.
rows.limits: Pay-As-You-Go is off by default, so jobs stop running on Build Hub once the monthly budget is used. 14-day free trial available. Bitrise published a security incident report (published Nov 19, 2026) linked from this pricing page: an AI-driven attacker had access from Nov 13, 2026, Bitrise switched the platform off at 20:34 UTC that day, rotated credentials and rebuilt its build infrastructure; files in 15 customer workspaces were accessed. The report states Bitrise is safe to use and recommends customers rotate secrets stored in Bitrise. See https://bitrise.io/artex-incident-report

rows.name: Bitrise Hobby
rows.price_note: Free forever plan; credit card verification required.
rows.includes: 500 build minutes per month on Linux or macOS, 1 private app, unlimited public apps, pipelines, unlimited workflow steps, 1 free on-prem runner, unlimited team members.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Optional Pay-As-You-Go: extra minutes charged at 1.5x the per-minute rate, capped at $15 per month; PAYG charges under $5 are not billed.
rows.limits: Builds time out at 90 minutes. Pay-As-You-Go is off unless switched on; at the $15 cap no new builds start until the next cycle. Bitrise published a security incident report (published Nov 19, 2026) linked from this pricing page: an AI-driven attacker had access from Nov 13, 2026, Bitrise switched the platform off at 20:34 UTC that day, rotated credentials and rebuilt its build infrastructure; files in 15 customer workspaces were accessed. The report states Bitrise is safe to use and recommends customers rotate secrets stored in Bitrise. See https://bitrise.io/artex-incident-report

rows.name: Blacksmith free tier
rows.price_note: Free minutes each month, then pay as you go.
rows.includes: 3,000 x64 2vCPU minutes per month per organization, worth $12 at the $0.004 Ubuntu x64 list rate (computed). ARM, Windows, macOS and larger runners draw these down at conversion rates: 1 ARM 2vCPU minute = 0.625, 1 Windows 2vCPU minute = 2, and 1 macOS 6vCPU minute = 20 x64 2vCPU minutes. The smallest macOS runner has 6 vCPUs.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Paid per minute: Ubuntu x64 $0.004, Ubuntu ARM $0.0025, Windows x64 $0.008, macOS M4 $0.08. Docker layer caching and sticky disks are $0.50/GB per month; static IPs are $100/IP per month.
rows.limits: No concurrency limit on jobs or vCPUs. The pages read show no spend limit for CI runners: the monthly spend limit in Settings covers [code]smith only. If a charge fails, [code]smith may be restricted, but CI runners continue to run and accrue charges.

rows.name: Buildkite Free plan
rows.price_note: Free plan; starts with a 30-day all-access trial, no credit card.
rows.includes: Up to 5 users, up to 10 concurrent jobs on self-hosted agents, up to 2,000 Linux AMD64 vCPU minutes per month on hosted agents (Small size only, up to 20 vCPU concurrency), 250k test executions per month, 1 GB/month of OpenTelemetry traces (hard cap), 50 GB/month artifact storage, 30-day build retention.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Pro is $30 per active user per month with 4,000 Linux AMD64 vCPU minutes and extra minutes at per-minute rates (rates not shown on this page).
rows.limits: No ARM64, macOS or Windows hosted agents on Free. Community support only.

rows.name: CircleCI Free
rows.price_note: Free plan, no credit card required.
rows.includes: 30,000 credits per month (up to 6,000 build minutes on a small Docker resource class; 3,000 minutes on Linux Medium at 10 credits per minute), up to 5 active users, Docker, Windows, Linux, Arm and macOS plus self-hosted runners, 30 concurrent jobs, 1 GB network and 2 GB storage included.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Performance plan credits cost $15 per 25,000; prepaid bulk from 1 million credits for $600.
rows.limits: Free plan credits expire after a month and do not roll over. Self-hosted runners limited to 5 concurrent tasks. Network and storage beyond plan thresholds is charged at 420 credits per GB.

rows.name: CircleCI Performance
rows.price_note: Starting at $15 per month; usage-based credits.
rows.includes: The 30,000 free monthly credits plus purchased credits at $15 per 25,000, 5 active users included, larger resource classes, 80 concurrent jobs, 20 concurrent self-hosted runner tasks, 5 GB network and 2 GB storage included.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $15 per 25,000 credits; extra active users $15 per month (25,000 credits each). Paid credits roll over and expire after 12 months.
rows.limits: When credits run out the account automatically refills 25% of the monthly amount, minimum 25,000 credits. The included 30,000 free credits do not roll over.

rows.name: GitHub Enterprise Cloud (included Actions)
rows.price_note: USD per user per month. The pricing page says Enterprise now includes access to GitHub Copilot.
rows.includes: $300 per month of included Actions compute, which covers 50,000 Linux 2-core minutes at $0.006 (pricing page: 50,000 CI/CD minutes per month). 50 GB artifact storage, 10 GB cache per repository, 150 GB custom image storage. Larger runners, the GPU runner among them, can draw from the included amount.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Past $300: Linux 2-core x64 $0.006/min, Linux 2-core arm64 $0.005/min, Linux 4-core GPU $0.052/min. Storage past the allowance: $0.25 per GB-month for artifacts and Packages, $0.07 for cache, $0.07 for custom image storage.
rows.limits: Past the included amount, usage bills the payment method on file. A budget set to stop usage can block Actions spend. Without a valid payment method, usage is blocked once included compute is used. Standard GitHub-hosted runners: 500 concurrent jobs, at most 50 macOS jobs.

rows.name: GitHub Actions on GitHub Free
rows.price_note: GitHub Free plan. GitHub Pro is a paid plan with a larger allowance.
rows.includes: Private repositories: $12 of included compute per month on GitHub Free (also GitHub Free for organizations), with 500 MB artifact storage and 10 GB cache per repository. GitHub Pro gets $18 and 1 GB. At $0.006 per Linux 2-core minute, $12 covers 2,000 minutes and $18 covers 3,000 (computed here; github.com/pricing also shows 2,000 CI/CD minutes on Free). Cloud sandbox compute and memory now draw from the same included amount. Standard GitHub-hosted runners in public repositories, GitHub Pages and Dependabot are free and do not draw on the allowance.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Per minute: Linux 1-core $0.002, Linux 2-core x64 $0.006, Linux 2-core arm64 $0.005, Windows 2-core x64 $0.010, Windows 2-core arm64 $0.010, macOS 3 or 4-core $0.062. Extra storage $0.25 per GB-month (artifacts and Packages), $0.07 per GB-month (cache).
rows.limits: 6 hours per job and 35 days per workflow run. 20 concurrent jobs on Free (40 on Pro), with at most 5 macOS jobs. Without a payment method, usage is blocked once the included amount is used. With a payment method on file, extra usage bills unless a budget stops it; the page states no default $0 budget.

rows.name: GitLab Premium
rows.price_note: $29 per user per month, billed annually.
rows.includes: 10,000 compute minutes per month, 500 GiB storage, unlimited licensed users, advanced CI/CD, and $8 of included GitLab Credits per user per month for AI features (a limited-time promotional offer per the page).
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Extra compute minutes $10 per 1,000; GitLab Credits $1 each.
rows.limits: Price is per user and billed annually. Minutes are counted per top-level namespace with the same cost factors as Free.

rows.name: GitLab.com Free
rows.price_note: Free tier on GitLab.com, no credit card required.
rows.includes: 400 compute minutes per month on GitLab-hosted instance runners, 5 users per top-level group, 10 GiB storage, source code management and CI/CD, static application security testing.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Extra compute minutes are $10 per 1,000 minutes (one-time purchase, rolls over). Cost factors: Linux x86-64 small 1, medium 2, large 3, xlarge 6, 2xlarge 12, GPU standard 7, macOS M1 medium 6 (beta), Windows medium 1 (beta).
rows.limits: Quota is enforced on Free namespaces on GitLab.com; the docs say enforcement measures apply when the quota is exceeded but do not detail them. Usage resets on the first day of each month. Public projects in the GitLab for Open Source program get a 0.5 cost factor. AI features need purchased GitLab Credits.

rows.name: TeamCity Cloud free trial

rows.includes: 12,000 build credits, good for up to 20 build hours on the Linux small instance type.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Credits are purchased in packs of 25,000; the page gives no price.

rows.name: Semaphore Cloud free monthly credits

rows.includes: $15 of credits per month (about 2,000 Ubuntu x64 2-vCPU minutes per the page), usable across services; 20 concurrent jobs by default; 20 GB/month artifact egress and 100 GB/month artifact storage; 9.6 GB cache per project.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Per-minute rates listed on the page include Ubuntu x64 $0.0075 (2 vCPU) and $0.015 (4 vCPU), macOS $0.09 (4 vCPU), self-hosted $0.0025 per minute on any machine. Extra artifact egress $0.35/GB, storage $0.07/GB.
rows.limits: The page does not say whether a card is required or what happens when the credits run out.

rows.name: AWS Free plan
rows.price_note: Free plan: no charges unless you upgrade to the Paid plan or activate paid-only services. New customers on the Paid plan also get up to $200 in credits.
rows.includes: $100 in credits at sign-up plus up to $100 more earned by completing activities with foundational services (up to $200), usable for up to 6 months. Free plan is limited to select services (the page says over 90). Separately, 30+ services have Always Free monthly limits on both Free and Paid plans.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0 within credit
rows.limits: The Free plan ends 6 months after account creation or when credits run out, whichever comes first, and cannot be extended. AWS then suspends the account; data is kept 90 days, during which an upgrade to the Paid plan restores access, after which the account and content are erased. Usage past Always Free limits is paid from credits; once credits are exhausted you must upgrade. Paid plan: spend limit from $20 per project can pause resources. Accounts that already had an AWS account are not eligible. The FAQ gives two different credit expiry periods after an upgrade (12 months in one answer, 6 months in another). A Free plan account is not eligible for promotional credits; a Paid plan account is.

rows.name: Claude Code on the web (cloud sessions)
rows.price_note: No separate charge for the cloud VM. Needs a paid plan: Pro is $20 billed monthly, or $17 per month on an annual subscription ($200 billed up front) (claude.com/pricing). Usage counts toward the plan's limits.
rows.includes: One isolated Anthropic-managed VM per session, Ubuntu 24.04 on x86_64, with approximate ceilings of 4 vCPUs, 16 GB RAM and 30 GB disk that may change over time. The docs list no GPU. Available on Pro, Max, Ultra and Team plans, and to Enterprise users with premium or Chat + Claude Code seats.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: No per-VM charge. Usage draws on the plan's usage limits.
rows.limits: Cloud sessions share rate limits with all other Claude and Claude Code usage. Network access has three levels (None, Limited, Full); the default is Limited with 'Allow package managers' checked, and environments saved as the former 'Trusted' level open as Limited. Foreground commands wait 2 minutes by default (up to 10); a command moved to the background runs up to 30 more minutes. After a few minutes without activity the VM pauses with files saved, and a paused VM can later be reclaimed. GitHub is needed to clone and push from GitHub, but a repository with no GitHub remote can be bundled from the terminal and uploaded (bundle under 100 MB). Members governed by custom roles need the cloud sessions permission. Organizations with Zero Data Retention, HIPAA configuration or customer-managed keys cannot use cloud sessions.

rows.name: Cirrus Runners
rows.price_note: $150 per runner per month. Discounts (mutually exclusive, applied by support): 15% for a 12-month commitment, 50% for non-revenue projects.
rows.includes: 1 concurrent runner with no limit on minutes. The same $150 buys one of: Linux x86 16 vCPU / 48 GB (KVM), Linux arm64 8 vCPU / 24 GB, macOS 4 M4 Pro vCPU / 16 GB, or Linux GPU 8 vCPU / 24 GB with an Nvidia GPU.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $150 per concurrent slot
rows.limits: Concurrency equals the number of runners bought; workflows labelled low-priority yield to regular ones near the concurrency limit. Subscription can be changed at any time.

rows.name: Cloudflare Workers Paid
rows.price_note: Minimum charge per account per month.
rows.includes: 10 million requests and 30 million CPU milliseconds per month. Covers Workers, Pages Functions, Workers KV, Hyperdrive and Durable Objects. No charge for egress or duration. Free plan for comparison: 100,000 requests per day and 10 ms of CPU per invocation.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0.30 per additional million requests. $0.02 per additional million CPU milliseconds. Requests to static assets are free.
rows.limits: CPU time up to 5 minutes per request (default 30 seconds). Cron Triggers: up to 5 minutes CPU (default 30 seconds) for intervals under 1 hour, 15 minutes for intervals of 1 hour or more. Queue consumers: 15 minutes wall time per invocation. 128 MB memory per Worker isolate. On Free, requests past 100,000 a day get Error 1027.

rows.name: Databricks Free Edition

rows.includes: One serverless workspace with a daily compute quota. No classic compute and no custom compute configurations.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free

If you pass the daily quota, compute is shut down for the rest of the day; data and settings are kept. Free Edition accounts may not be used for commercial purposes. rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0 within the free usage

rows.name: Depot Developer
rows.price_note: Per month; 7-day trial. Billed monthly on the 1st, prorated in the first month; paid by credit card through Stripe.
rows.includes: Each month: 2,000 sandbox minutes (one pool shared by Depot CI, Depot Sandboxes and Depot Managed Agents, measured at 2 vCPUs), 2,000 GitHub Actions minutes, 500 container build minutes, 25 GB cache and registry storage, 1,000,000 passing test results. 1 user, unlimited concurrency.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Additional usage: GitHub Actions runners $0.006/min (base 2-vCPU Linux), container builds $0.04/min (default 16-vCPU builder), sandbox compute $0.00005 per second per vCPU, storage $0.20 per GB-month, test results $0.000001 per passing test. Billed per second with no one-minute minimum.
rows.limits: Self-imposed usage caps are available; at a cap Depot stops running builds until next month or until the cap is raised. Larger builders (above 16 vCPU), RBAC and SSO are not on Developer.

rows.name: Fly.io Free plan
rows.price_note: $1 one-time credit without a card (expires after 7 days); $5 of usage every month once a card is added.
rows.includes: The credit covers Machines, volumes and snapshots, data transfer, Sprites and one Managed Postgres cluster on the $4 Developer plan. New Free organizations with a card also get a $30 Sprites credit. Always free on every plan: first 10 GB of volume snapshots, first 10 single-hostname certificates, inbound data, shared IPv4 and IPv6.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Machine prices: shared-cpu-1x 256 MB $2.19/month, 512 MB $3.69, 1 GB $6.70, shared-cpu-2x 2 GB $13.39, performance-1x 2 GB $33.00, billed per second while running.
rows.limits: Personal organization only, 1 member, up to 3 Machines (no performance Machines), volumes up to 5 GB, up to 3 Sprites, community support. Going over $5 moves the organization to Pay As You Go automatically and the whole month is billed at standard rates from the first cent. One Free plan per card. Without a card, new resources cannot be created once the $1 is used or after 7 days.

rows.name: GitHub Codespaces included usage (personal accounts)

Compute draws down at an included-usage multiplier equal to the core count (2 for a 2-core machine, 4 for 4-core), so 120 hours is about 60 hours on a 2-core machine.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Paid rates: 2 core $0.18/hour, 4 core $0.36, 8 core $0.72, 16 core $1.44, 32 core $2.88; storage $0.07 per GB-month.
rows.limits: Without a payment method, usage is blocked once the quota is used up until the next billing cycle; with one, usage above the quota is billed. Organization and enterprise plans get no free Codespaces quota. Prebuilds also consume GitHub Actions minutes.

rows.name: GitHub Team
rows.price_note: USD per user per month on github.com/pricing. The page lists no first-12-months promotion.

Larger runners, the GPU runner among them, can draw from the included amount on Team.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0 inside the $18 included amount. Past it, standard rates: Linux 2-core x64 $0.006/min, Linux 2-core arm64 $0.005/min.
rows.limits: Past the included amount, usage bills the payment method on file. A budget set to stop usage can block Actions spend at a chosen amount. The docs state no default spending limit. Standard runners: 60 concurrent jobs, at most 5 macOS; larger runners: 1,000 concurrent jobs, 100 GPU jobs.

rows.name: GitHub-hosted runners (pay-as-you-go rates)

rows.includes: Per-minute rates: Linux 1-core x64 $0.002, Linux 2-core x64 $0.006, Linux 2-core arm64 $0.005, Windows 2-core x64 $0.010, Windows 2-core arm64 $0.010, macOS 3 or 4-core $0.062. Standard runners are free in public repositories. Self-hosted runners are free and do not reduce included compute.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Baseline: Linux 2-core x64 $0.006/min ($0.36 per hour). 25,000 minutes cost $150 (derived: 25,000 x $0.006).
rows.limits: Without a valid payment method, usage is blocked once the included compute is used. Concurrent jobs depend on the GitHub plan.

rows.name: Google Cloud Free Tier (always free products)
rows.price_note: Free up to monthly limits. A separate Free Trial gives $300 of Welcome credit valid for 90 days.
rows.includes: Compute Engine: 1 non-preemptible e2-micro VM per month in us-west1, us-central1 or us-east1, free up to the hours in the month, plus 30 GB-months of standard persistent disk and 1 GB of outbound transfer from North America. Cloud Run (request-based billing): 2 million requests, 360,000 GB-seconds of memory and 180,000 vCPU-seconds per month. Cloud Build: 2,500 build-minutes per month on e2-standard-2.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Usage beyond the limits bills at standard rates on a Paid billing account. On a Free Trial account the $300 credit pays for it.
rows.limits: GPUs and TPUs are not part of the Free Tier and are always charged. A Free Trial account cannot add GPUs to VM instances. Free Trial signup requires a credit card or other payment method. If the Free Trial ends without an upgrade, the page says access to Google Cloud products is lost.

rows.name: Google Cloud free trial

rows.includes: $300 Welcome credit valid for 90 days, plus full access to the Free Tier.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0 within credit

While on the trial you cannot add GPUs, use Marketplace, request quota increases, create Windows Server VMs or VMware Engine resources. The credit cannot pay for Gemini API in AI Studio, partner models as a service, or, for sign-ups or upgrades on or after November 16, 2026, Gemini platform (formerly Vertex AI) services. When the credit or 90 days runs out without an upgrade, billing is disabled, resources stop and are deleted after a 30-day grace period.

rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Past credits, same rates as Starter: runners x64 $0.002 per vCPU-min, macOS $0.020 per vCPU-min; billed per second.

rows.name: Azure free account
rows.price_note: $200 credit for 30 days, then pay as you go. Needs a phone number, a non-prepaid credit or debit card and a Microsoft or GitHub account.
rows.includes: $200 credit to use within 30 days. Free monthly amounts of 20+ popular services for 12 months. Free monthly amounts of 65+ always-free services.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0 within the credit and the free amounts
rows.limits: New Azure customers only, one account with free services and the $200 credit per new customer. Move to pay-as-you-go within 30 days or after you use the credit; if you do not, the account and services are disabled, and you resume by moving to pay as you go. rows.includes: 100,000 unit minutes shared across CI and remote builds (1 unit = 1 vCPU + 2 GB for a minute on Linux; Windows x2, macOS x10): 25,000 min at 2 vCPU / 8 GB or 50,000 at 2 vCPU / 4 GB (computed). 1,000 Docker builds, 5,000 GB-hr cache snapshots and 3,000 GB-day cache storage free. rows.name: Oracle Cloud Always Free (OCI Ampere A1 Compute)

rows.includes: RTX 3090 $0.09-0.20, RTX 4090 $0.16-0.44, RTX 5090 $0.25-0.60 per GPU-hour (Lowest to High priority), vCPU and RAM included.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Lowest tier x 730 h: RTX 5090 $182.50/month, RTX 4090 $116.80, RTX 3090 $65.70. RunPod Community RTX 4090 $0.34/h (read today).
rows.limits: No free trial. Lower priority tiers can be preempted by higher ones; Lowest is the most interruptible.

rows.name: Saturn Cloud free
rows.includes: A free account (Hosted Free) to try the platform. The page says to upgrade to Hosted Pro 'to unlock resource usage capabilities'. No free compute hours, GPU or RAM amounts are stated.
rows.limits: Hosted Pro: $5 up-front credit charge, then the card is charged every $10 of usage. Saturn Cloud's own price is $0.00/hour; you pay the hosting price (e.g. Nebius 1x H100 $2.95/h, AWS T4 g4dn.xlarge $0.53/h).

rows.name: ThinkDiffusion TD-Pro
rows.price_note: $29.99 billed monthly, or $19.99 per month billed yearly.
rows.includes: $10 monthly balance credit (unused credits roll over), 20% off machine rates, 200 GB private drive with persistent storage. ULTRA 48 GB $1.99/h (standard $2.50).
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: ULTRA 48 GB $1.99/h on TD-Pro vs $2.50 standard; RunPod Community RTX A6000 $0.33 (read today).

rows.name: Tinker (Thinking Machines)
rows.price_note: Per million tokens, by model and context length, as of October 19, 2026 per the page. The page names no free credit and no plan fee.
rows.includes: Training, sampling and prefill, billed per million tokens. Train price for example: $0.396 for GPT-OSS-20B at 32K, $0.44 for Qwen3-8B at 32K, $4.103 for Qwen3.8-27B at 64K and $1.50 for Inkling 2 Small at 64K. Checkpoint storage is $0.10 per GB per month. Serverless inference is in beta for Inkling 2 Small, Inkling and Inkling-Small only.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Mixture-of-experts models are priced by active parameters. Cached prefill is cheaper than prefill: for example $0.03 against $0.30 per million tokens for Inkling 2 Small.
rows.limits: The pricing page states no card requirement, billing model or data terms.

rows.name: Thunder Compute
rows.includes: On-demand instances billed per minute while running, at these hourly rates: RTX A6000 $0.35, L40 $0.79, A100 80GB $1.09, H100 SXM $3.20 per GPU-hour. Extra vCPU $0.04/vCPU-hr; instance disk beyond the first 100 GB per GPU $0.219/GB-month; snapshots $0.05/GB-month; no egress fees. Sandboxes (per-second billing, access by request): H100 SXM $2.95, A100 80GB $1.95 per GPU-hour.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Thunder's own comparison table (on-demand list prices checked Nov 22, 2026): H100 $3.20 vs Lambda $3.79, Runpod $4.39, AWS $6.88 per GPU-hour. These are the vendor's claims about competitors.
rows.limits: Instances and sandboxes are never preempted. Reserved and volume pricing are by sales quote.

rows.name: Vast.ai reserved
rows.includes: Reserved: 1, 3 or 6-month terms, up to 50% off, guaranteed capacity, volume discounts; the pricing page sends reservations to Contact Sales. Interruptible: 50%+ cheaper than on-demand, may be reclaimed. Per-second billing; prices set by supply and demand.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Up to 50% off on-demand marketplace rates (vendor's wording). Live rates vary; no fixed reserved price is published.

rows.name: Verda (ex-DataCrunch) spot
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Spot is half of Verda's own on-demand price (B200 $4.874 vs $9.747; H200 $3.522 vs $7.043; A100 80GB $1.235 vs $2.470).

rows.name: OpenCode Go
rows.price_note: $10 a month for Go. Go Plus is $40 a month. Go Teams is $20 per member per month with a 2-member minimum ($40 a month).
rows.includes: One monthly allowance shared by all paid models. Each model's monthly limit (the amount covered if you use only that model) runs from $15 to $200 at OpenCode's token prices: for example Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT 6 Luna, Grok 4.7 and Kimi K3 at $15, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at $100, GLM-5.3 at $200. Models include Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT 6 Luna, GPT 5.6 Luna, Gemini 4 Argon, Grok 4.7, and open models (GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, MiMo, DeepSeek, Hy, Step, LongCat, Muse Spark Contributor). The 5-hour limit is 20% and the weekly limit 50% of the monthly allowance; the weekly limit resets Monday 00:00 UTC.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Claude Haiku 5.5 costs $0.10/$0.50 per M, the same as Anthropic's list price, with a $15 limit. Per-model limits run from 1.5x to 20x the $10 fee (computed). Gemini 4 Argon is 50% off through November 30, 2026. DeepSeek models cost 2x on weekdays from 01:00 to 04:00 and 06:00 to 10:00 UTC.
rows.limits: At a limit you can keep using the free models, or opt in to Extra Usage, which draws on a Console pay-as-you-go balance (Go Teams starts with Extra Usage on). Default regions are Europe and United States. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro and LongCat 2.5 (hosted in China) need the Global region. Muse Spark Contributor models need 'Allow paid endpoints that train on request data'. Workspaces with no saved privacy settings also allow Global for requests from China. Clients should send x-opencode-session and their own user agent. Terms allow your own internal use only. Trap: save the privacy settings with Global off and the training toggle off.

rows.name: Claude API prepaid credits (Claude Console)
rows.price_note: No subscription. Prepaid usage credits bought in the Claude Console; billed per token at list price.
rows.includes: Per million tokens, input/output: Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50 for prompts up to 100K tokens and $0.50/$2.50 above; Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10; Opus 5.5 $4/$20; Fable 5.2 $8/$40 (Fable 5.1 is still $10/$50). Batch API halves input and output prices.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: List price. Batch API is 50 percent off; US-only inference costs 1.1x; fast mode costs 2x (Opus 5.5 $8/$40, Fable 5.2 $16/$80).
rows.limits: Bought credits expire one year after purchase and cannot be extended or refunded. When credits run out the API stops until you add more; auto-reload is optional. Rate limits depend on the account's usage tier (not read here).

rows.name: Aqua Voice API first $1.00 free
rows.price_note: Your first $1.00 of usage is free, and the first request needs no card.
rows.includes: $1.00 of free usage. Transcription (Avalon) is $0.39 per hour of audio and dictation (Aqua) is $0.49 per hour. Edit Mode is priced at the dictation rate.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Both are billed per second with a 10-second minimum; failed requests and idempotent replays are never billed, and there are no seat fees.
rows.limits: The page does not say what happens when the $1.00 is used up or state rate limits and training terms. Retention depends on the user's privacy and zero-data-retention settings.

rows.name: ArliAI Core (Plus $20, Pro $30)
rows.price_note: Core $15, Plus $20, Pro $30 and Max $160 a month; 10% off when paid annually.
rows.includes: Core: unlimited tokens and requests, 1 request at a time, standard priority, models up to 552B, 32K context, image generation up to 3 MP. Plus: 128K context. Pro: 2 parallel requests, high priority, 256K context. Max: 6 parallel requests, 512K context.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Flat
rows.limits: The page headline says 'Unlimited. Zero-Log. Monthly Pricing.' Core is limited to 32K context and 1 request at a time.

rows.name: AssemblyAI free credit
rows.includes: Up to $50 of audio on a limited trial: pre-recorded transcription, Speech Understanding and streaming speech-to-text. LLM Gateway is not on the free tier.
rows.limits: Once the $50 is used, the API returns an error until you add a card and upgrade.

rows.name: Baseten new-customer credits
rows.price_note: Choose $250 in Dedicated Inference or $100 in Model API credits; the page says they expire in 1 month.
rows.includes: Either $250 in Dedicated Inference or $100 in Model API credits.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0 within the credit
rows.limits: New Baseten customers only. Credits go only to valid business emails for valid business use cases, and terms apply. The page does not say how the credit is issued beyond a request form. This catalog lists none of the OpenAI, xAI or SpaceX models the platform may also host.

rows.name: Cerebras Inference Free Trial
rows.price_note: One-time $5 promotional credit; there is no permanently free tier.
rows.includes: $5 in credits after adding a verified payment method, valid 30 days, usable on every Shared Inference model. Free Trial limits: gpt-oss-120b 5 RPM, 30K uncached TPM, 90K total TPM, 1M tokens per hour and 1M tokens per day. qwen-3.8-27b 300 RPM, 150K uncached TPM, 750K total TPM (temporarily raised from 450K), no hourly or daily token caps, the same as Pay as You Go.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Pay as you go credits after the trial; rates not read here.
rows.limits: Without a payment method, Playground and API access stay inactive. Access pauses when the credit expires or runs out. The pricing page says the tier is for development, evaluation and experimentation, not production.

rows.name: Chutes Plus (Pro $20)
rows.price_note: ENDED. Monthly plans are no longer sold. Existing plans stay active to the end of the current billing period, do not renew, and then bill pay-as-you-go from the account balance. Chutes offers no free tier.
rows.includes: Offer ended. Chutes now sells only pay-per-token inference (for example Qwen3.8-27B-TEE $0.039 input and $1.25 output per M) and Private Chutes on TEE GPUs (RTX Pro 6000 $2.25 an hour plus a one-time deploy fee of 3x the hourly rate).
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: 6% (Pro 10%) off PAYG
rows.limits: Pay-as-you-go from a prepaid account balance, with no subscription and no minimum. Volume pricing is by sales quote.

rows.name: Cloudflare AI Search (formerly AutoRAG)
rows.price_note: No separate subscription. AI Search billing begins December 1, 2026. Each account gets included usage every month on Workers Free and Workers Paid; usage past it is metered.
rows.includes: Monthly: 5 million ingestion tokens (image-processing tokens share this allotment), 10 GB-month storage, 1,000 semantic queries, 1,000 full-text queries. OCR is available on every account and bills as image-processing tokens. Workers AI embedding and reranking, R2, Vectorize and Browser Run crawling done for AI Search are included in AI Search usage. Generation, query rewriting, file summaries and external models bill through Workers AI or AI Gateway.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Ingestion $0.75 per M tokens (images add $0.50 per M); storage $2.00 per GB-month; semantic, vector or hybrid queries $0.75 per 1,000; full-text queries $0.10 per 1,000; instances past 5,000 on Paid $0.10 a month each.
rows.limits: Workers Free: 100 instances, 100,000 files per instance, 500 crawled pages a day. Workers Paid: 5,000 instances by default, 1M files per instance (500K for hybrid search), no daily crawl cap. Both: 100 namespaces, 10 MiB max for OCR PDFs and text files, 4 MiB for other formats, 100,000 pages per discover crawl. A legacy R2 crawl bucket can still bill R2 storage.

rows.name: Cloudflare Workers AI free daily allocation
rows.price_note: Free on both Workers plans, Free and Paid. Usage above it needs Workers Paid, where it bills.
rows.includes: 10,000 Neurons per day. At the page's rates that is about 314K gpt-oss-120b input tokens (31,818 Neurons per million) or about 96 FLUX.2 Klein 4B 1024x1024 outputs (4 output tiles at 26.05 Neurons each).
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Workers Paid only: $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons above 10,000 per day. Workers Free has no overage option.
rows.limits: Limits reset at 00:00 UTC. On Workers Free, use past the allocation fails with an error. On Workers Paid, it bills at $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons. Nine models (two Kimi, three GLM, three DeepSeek and Inkling 2 Small) require a paid billing method: Workers Paid or prepaid AI Gateway credits.

rows.name: Cloudflare Workers AI past the free allocation
rows.price_note: Needs the Workers Paid plan, minimum $5 a month per account, then usage. Prepaid AI Gateway credits are an alternative way to pay.
rows.includes: 10,000 Neurons a day free on both Workers plans. Past that, Workers Paid bills $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons. Example LLM rates: gpt-oss-120b $0.350 input and $0.750 output per M tokens; llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast $0.293 and $2.253.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons, shown per model as per-token prices.
rows.limits: On Workers Free, requests past 10,000 Neurons a day fail with an error until 00:00 UTC. Text generation defaults to 300 requests per minute. The nine models that need a paid billing method (Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, Inkling) instead get 20 requests per minute per model, or 50 with prepaid AI Gateway credits on Unified billing.

rows.name: Deepgram Startup Program
rows.price_note: By application: direct applicants start at a $1,000 starter offer.
rows.includes: A $1,000 starter offer for direct applicants, with larger tiers as usage grows, up to $100,000 in credits over 12 months.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0 within the credit
rows.limits: Open to an AI builder or early-stage startup in production or launching within 6 months, who commits to engage with Deepgram's community. The page states no incorporation requirement. Companies that raised over $10M and existing customers are reviewed case by case. Each grant expires 12 months after issue. Deepgram typically replies within a week and credits appear in the console 24 to 48 hours after acceptance. Agencies building for clients are excluded. The separate $200 sign-up credit is not part of the program.

rows.name: ElevenLabs Creator
rows.price_note: $22 a month; annual billing $18.33 a month. Black Friday until December 1, 2026: $8.25 a month for the first year on annual billing ($99 for the year). The FAQ also lists $11 for the first month.
rows.includes: 121,000 credits a month (about 121 minutes of text to speech), Professional Voice Cloning, 30 custom voice slots, 5 concurrent requests, 128 and 192 kbps audio.
rows.limits: 5 concurrent requests. Unused credits roll over for up to two months (balance up to 3x the monthly quota) while subscribed. PAYG top-ups start at $5, expire 12 months after purchase and are non-refundable.

rows.name: ElevenLabs Free
rows.price_note: $0 per month.
rows.includes: 10,000 credits per month, about 10 minutes of text to speech (1 credit per character on V2 Multilingual). 3 Studio projects.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free; paid plans start with Starter at $6 per month for 30,000 credits.
rows.limits: Non-commercial use only, with a personal email address. No credit rollover on Free. Content may be used for training unless you opt out. Optional PAYG top-ups (minimum $5) work on Free and raise concurrency to the Starter level (3), but voice slots and other plan limits stay at the Free level.

rows.name: ElevenLabs Starter
rows.price_note: $6 a month; annual billing $5 a month (monthly price times 10 per year). The page still shows a 'First month for $1' banner, but it is marked 'Ends September 30', so that promotion has lapsed.
rows.includes: 30,000 credits a month (about 30 minutes of text to speech), commercial license, Instant Voice Cloning, 20 Studio projects, 10 custom voice slots, 3 concurrent requests.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: The pricing table lists about $0.20 per extra minute for Starter. Pay-as-you-go top-ups start at $5 and expire 12 months after purchase.
rows.limits: 3 concurrent requests. Unused credits roll over for up to two months (balance up to 3x the monthly quota) while subscribed. Usage-based billing is not offered to new self-serve customers; service pauses at a zero top-up balance unless Auto Top Up is on.

rows.name: Featherless Chat
rows.includes: Unlimited tokens, 4 concurrent, 32K context
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Flat, but human use only
rows.limits: Interactive, human-driven use by the purchaser only: no reselling, app or API traffic, background automation or benchmarking. Misuse may lead to cancellation without refund. 40,000+ open models. Prompts and completions are never stored. Billed monthly; cancel any time. Switching to Developer mid-period forfeits the rest of the period.

rows.name: Featherless Developer
rows.price_note: From $50 a month (credit amount selectable), billed per token.
rows.includes: $50 or more of metered credits a month, context up to 256K, 100 concurrent units, 1 agent environment included, priority capacity.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: 1x (no discount)
rows.limits: Credits never expire and carry into later cycles. One-off top-ups any time. Only successful requests are billed. Requests are blocked at zero credit. Prompts are never stored. No reselling.

rows.name: Fireworks Fire Pass
rows.price_note: CLOSED TO NEW SUBSCRIPTIONS. Fire Pass is experimental and not open to new subscriptions; only existing users and promo recipients can manage a pass. No price is published.
rows.includes: Covered usage on enabled open-weight routers while the pass is active. kimi-fast-latest currently resolves to Kimi K3 Fast (1,040,000-token context, up to 131,072 output tokens), at $0 per token. Uses a dedicated fpk_ key.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Flat (was $7/week, 3p)
rows.limits: Personal, non-production agentic coding only. No Responses API (Codex, ChatGPT desktop), no auto or Nexus Auto, and Nexus CLI rejects Fire Pass keys. Violations may revoke the pass.

rows.name: Gemini API Free tier
rows.price_note: Free input and output tokens on selected models; the Paid tier is pay as you go.
rows.includes: Free of charge on the Free tier: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, 3.1 Flash-Lite, 3 Flash Preview, 2.5 Pro and 2.5 Flash (both deprecated), 2.5 Flash-Lite, Gemma 4, Gemini Embedding and Embedding 2, Gemini Decision 1, Robotics ER 2 previews, and the TTS, Live, Live Translate and Transcribe models. Not on the Free tier: Gemini 4 Carbon, 4 Argon, 4 Neon, Genie 4, Omni 1.2/1.1 Flash, 3.1 Pro Preview, the Nano Banana image models, 2.5 Pro Preview TTS, and Lyria 3/3.5.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free
rows.limits: Rate limits are per project and shown in AI Studio, not on the docs page. Daily quotas reset at midnight Pacific time. Apps made available to users in the EEA, Switzerland or the UK must use Paid Services. Free-tier content can be read by human reviewers. DEPRECATION: gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash are no longer selectable in AI Studio. From December 1, 2026, API calls to them route to gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.5-flash-lite respectively and bill at those rates.

rows.name: Groq Developer tier (pay as you go)
rows.price_note: No monthly fee. Pay per token, invoiced monthly in arrears, with early invoices when lifetime usage first crosses $1, $10, $100, $500 and $1,000.
rows.includes: Higher rate limits than Free, Batch and Flex processing, spend limits and chat support. gpt-oss-120b: $0.15 input, $0.075 cached input, $0.60 output per M tokens.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Per-token list price; this tier is the pay-as-you-go option.
rows.limits: The rate-limits page now has a separate Developer Plan table: gpt-oss-120b 1K RPM, 500K RPD, 250K TPM (no TPD listed); qwen3.8-27b the same; whisper-large-v3 300 RPM, 200K RPD, 200K ASH, 4M ASD. Exact limits show on the signed-in limits page. Zero Data Retention is available to all customers and disables batch and fine-tuning. Customer data is stored in US Google Cloud buckets.

rows.name: GroqCloud Free plan
rows.price_note: Free plan; the Developer plan is the paid upgrade.
rows.includes: The docs page lists these base limits for its models, and says they are the Developer plan's: openai/gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b at 30 RPM, 1K requests per day, 8K TPM and 200K tokens per day; qwen/qwen3.8-27b with the same limits; whisper-large-v3 at 20 RPM, 2K requests per day, 7.2K audio seconds per hour and 28.8K per day.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free
rows.limits: The page shows only the Developer plan's base limits, so the Free plan's own limits may differ; they are on the console limits page. Limits are per organization. Requests over a limit get HTTP 429. Groq does not retain inference data by default but may log it for up to 30 days for reliability or abuse checks.

rows.name: Hugging Face PRO
rows.price_note: $9 a month. The pricing page shows no yearly price.
rows.includes: $2 of compute credits monthly for Inference Providers, Inference Endpoints, Spaces hardware (including ZeroGPU past quota) and Jobs. 8x ZeroGPU quota with highest queue priority. 10x private storage.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Provider rates with no Hugging Face markup.
rows.limits: Use past the $2 credit needs purchased credits for routed requests. Credits do not apply to requests made with your own provider key. Each provider's own data policy applies.

rows.name: LLM Gateway DevPass Lite
rows.price_note: $29 a month. Pro $79, Max $179. Self-serve first-month money-back guarantee.
rows.includes: $58 of model usage a month at provider rates (2x the fee), 200+ models, with a weekly premium allowance.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: 2x usage value at provider rates (vendor's figure): Lite $29 to $58, Pro $79 to $158, Max $179 to $358.
rows.limits: Weekly premium allowance; Reset Passes restore it (Max includes two a month, and any tier can buy one). First-month refund is self-serve from the billing dashboard.

rows.name: Mistral Studio Free mode
rows.price_note: Free. The pricing page lists a Free plan and says it includes access to Mistral Studio.
rows.includes: The Free plan includes access to Mistral Studio (pricing page FAQ), and the help article names a Studio Free mode. The pages read give no API allowance, token numbers or rate limits.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Not stated. The pricing page lists API pricing per million tokens, for example Mistral Large at $0.5 in and $1.5 out.
rows.limits: The API quickstart lists 'a plan with API access' as a prerequisite and links to billing setup to add a payment method, and the pages do not say a Free plan can generate a key. Per the help article, Free mode input and output may be used for training, and you can opt out at any time.

rows.name: NVIDIA API Catalog trial (build.nvidia.com)
rows.price_note: Free trial access to hosted model endpoints; production use needs a paid subscription.
rows.includes: Free inference on hosted models in the API Catalog, up to 40 requests per minute and 10,000 requests per day.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free
rows.limits: Rate limits vary by model, and other users' traffic can cause throttling. Trial terms allow internal testing and evaluation only, not production. NVIDIA may use User Content and Generated Content to improve products, including AI models.

rows.name: Ollama Max
rows.price_note: $100 a month. The pricing page shows no yearly price for Max.
rows.includes: Everything in Pro, $300 of usage credits per month, early access to the newest models, 10 concurrent requests.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $300 of credit for $100, so 3x face value at the pay-as-you-go rates (computed).
rows.limits: 10 concurrent requests; extra requests queue. Included credits do not roll over. Purchased credits are drawn after the included amount, so buying none keeps a hard stop.

rows.name: Ollama Pay as you go
rows.price_note: $0 a month and no subscription. Every cloud model is paid per token from usage credits you buy.
rows.includes: Unlimited models on your own hardware, 3 concurrent cloud requests and no service fees. No cloud usage is included: each cloud request is paid with usage credits.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: This plan is the pay-as-you-go rate.
rows.limits: One account per person. Requests past 3 concurrent queue, and a full queue rejects them. Cloud requests draw only on purchased usage credits, so buying none keeps a hard stop. Prompt and response data is never logged or trained on.

rows.name: Ollama Pro
rows.price_note: $20 a month, or $200 a year ($16.67 a month billed annually).
rows.includes: $60 of usage credits per month spent at the listed per-token rates, access to larger pro models, 3 concurrent requests. Fast mode is listed as coming soon.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $60 of credit for $20, so 3x face value at the pay-as-you-go rates (computed). Example rate: gpt-oss:120b $0.15 input and $0.60 output per million tokens.
rows.limits: 3 concurrent requests; extra requests queue, and a full queue rejects them. Included credits do not roll over. After the included credits, Ollama draws on any purchased credit balance, so buying no credits keeps a hard stop. Email warning at 90 percent of included usage.

rows.name: OpenCode Go Plus
rows.price_note: $40 a month.
rows.includes: One shared monthly allowance. Per-model monthly limits run from $60 to $400 (for example Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT 6 Luna and Kimi K3 $60, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash $200, GLM-5.3 $400). 5-hour (20%) and weekly (50%) sub-limits.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: 1.5x to 10x the $40 fee per model (computed from the models endpoint).
rows.limits: The same rules as Go: free models or opt-in Extra Usage at a limit; DeepSeek and LongCat need the Global region; Muse Spark Contributor needs the training toggle; the terms allow internal use only.

rows.name: OpenRouter free model variants (:free)
rows.price_note: Free model variants cost nothing; the daily cap rises after 10 credits purchased (all time).
rows.includes: 20 requests per minute. 50 requests per day with under 10 credits purchased all time, 1,000 requests per day with at least 10 credits purchased.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free
rows.limits: The higher daily cap starts one credit below the 10-credit threshold to absorb fees. A negative account balance can block free models too. Training depends on the provider; OpenRouter has a separate free-model privacy setting, and opting out stops routing to providers that train.

rows.name: OpenRouter pay-as-you-go credits (Standard plan)
rows.price_note: No monthly fee or minimum. A 5.5% fee on credit purchases ($0.80 minimum) on Standard; 5% for crypto payments; the Business plan fee is 8%.
rows.includes: 600+ models at each provider's list price. Free models: 20 requests a minute and 50 a day, rising to 1,000 a day after at least $10 of lifetime credit purchases. BYOK: $25,000 of list-price inference a month with no fee, then 5%.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Provider list price plus the 5.5% purchase fee.
rows.limits: No plan rate limit on paid models; provider limits pass through. A negative balance blocks free models. OpenRouter may expire unused credits one year after purchase. Providers that log or train are skipped unless the training toggle is on in privacy settings; Zero Data Retention routing is available on every plan.

rows.name: Poe subscription
rows.price_note: The monthly price is not on the docs page read. The $19.99 figure comes from a third-party page (3p) and is unconfirmed: poe.com/premium returned a 404 and the help center refused the read.
rows.includes: Poe subscribers can use their existing subscription points with the API at no additional cost, and add-on points can be bought. About 1M points per month (3p).
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: The docs state the intent to charge the same amount for model access that the underlying model providers charge.
rows.limits: Rate limit of 500 requests per minute, request-based only: the docs say Poe does not use token-based rate limiting.

rows.name: SambaCloud Free Tier
rows.price_note: Rate-limited free tier, applied when no payment method is linked.
rows.includes: gpt-oss-120b and gemma-4-31B-it at 20 requests per minute, 20 requests per day and 200,000 tokens per day each.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Developer Tier (card linked, pay per token) raises limits to 60 RPM and 12,000 RPD per model, capped at 20M tokens per day across models.
rows.limits: Docs state all SambaCloud models are Preview models for evaluation and experimentation only, not for production, and may be removed at short notice. The Plans console page instead says to add a payment method and purchase credits to run first requests, so free access without a card could not be confirmed end to end.

rows.name: Snowflake CoCo (Cortex Code) trial
rows.price_note: An introductory trial with $400 in credits, of which $40 is for CoCo inference. After it, a $20 monthly subscription applies.
rows.includes: $400 in credits for the first 30 days or until used up, whichever is earlier: $40 for Snowflake CoCo inference (CLI, Desktop and Web only) and $360 for all other fees, including compute, storage and other AI features.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0 within the credits; Snowflake bills CoCo by token consumption.
rows.limits: After the trial you are charged a $20 USD monthly subscription for all CoCo inference and data platform consumption, and you may cancel anytime. Subscriptions are subject to usage limits across AI and compute, and access may be suspended when they are reached. The page states no included inference amount for the subscription, so it has no row. This catalog lists none of the OpenAI, xAI or SpaceX models the platform may also host.

rows.name: Synthetic Standard (Go $9, Big $90, Bigger $300)
rows.price_note: Plans: Go $9, Standard $30, Big $90, Bigger $300 a month.
rows.includes: A weekly credit limit that regenerates 2% every 202 minutes (a full week from zero). There are no 5-hour or monthly limits. Credits are spent at discounted subscription rates. Includes 1 usage reset a month, Web Search API and beta models. Fast mode (2x speed, 2x credit use) and Infinite mode (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash only, slower, not counted against limits) come with Big and Bigger.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Subscription rate vs usage-based price per M tokens, input/output: Kimi K3.1 Pro $0.75/$6.00 vs $2.00/$10.00; Qwen3.8-27B $0.23/$1.10 vs $0.45/$2.20; gpt-oss-120b $0.01/$0.05 vs $0.10/$0.10.
rows.limits: Every plan allows extra usage at usage-based API pricing. You can buy more tokens or move to a higher plan.

rows.name: Venice Pro Plus (Max $200)
rows.includes: $75 API spend/mo (Max $225)
rows.limits: Unused credits roll forward: 2-month credit banking on Pro Plus, 3-month on Max. 100 credits = $1. One-time 500 welcome credits. API rate limits listed as 'Higher' (Pro Plus) and 'Highest' (Max).

rows.name: Cloudflare D1 on Workers Free
rows.price_note: Included in Workers Free.
rows.includes: 5 million rows read per day, 100,000 rows written per day, 5 GB total storage, 10 databases.
rows.limits: Daily limits reset at 00:00 UTC. Past the read or write limit, queries fail until reset. At the storage limit you must delete data before writing more.

rows.name: Cloudflare R2 free tier
rows.price_note: Free monthly allowance on Standard storage; usage above it is billed.
rows.includes: 10 GB-month storage, 1 million Class A operations and 10 million Class B operations per month, free egress. Standard storage only.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0.015 per GB-month, $4.50 per million Class A, $0.36 per million Class B, egress free.
rows.limits: You must add an R2 subscription through a checkout flow before use. The free tier does not cover Infrequent Access storage.

rows.name: Cloudflare Workers Free plan
rows.price_note: Free plan.
rows.includes: 100,000 requests per day, 10 ms CPU time per invocation, 128 MB memory, 50 subrequests per request, 100 Workers per account. KV: 100,000 reads and 1,000 writes per day, 1 GB stored. Durable Objects (SQLite only): 100,000 requests per day, 5 GB stored.
rows.limits: The daily request limit resets at midnight UTC. Past it, Cloudflare returns Error 1027: fail-open routes bypass the Worker, fail-closed routes show an error page.

rows.name: GitHub Pages
rows.price_note: Free for public repositories on GitHub Free; private repositories need Pro, Team or Enterprise.
rows.includes: Static site hosting. Published site up to 1 GB, soft bandwidth limit of 100 GB per month, soft limit of 10 builds per hour, 10-minute deployment timeout, one user or organization site per account.
rows.limits: Not allowed as free hosting for an online business, e-commerce, or commercial SaaS. Donation buttons and crowdfunding links are allowed. The build limit does not apply to custom GitHub Actions workflows. Over the limits, GitHub may stop serving the site or email you.

rows.name: Hugging Face Spaces CPU Basic
rows.price_note: CPU Basic has no hourly cost, but creating a Gradio or Docker Space now needs a paid plan.
rows.includes: CPU Basic: 2 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, 50 GB non-persistent disk. Static Spaces are free for everyone. Free personal accounts can host up to 2 Gradio Spaces on ZeroGPU.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: CPU Upgrade is $0.03 per hour.
rows.limits: A free account cannot create a new CPU Basic Gradio or Docker Space: that needs PRO (personal) or Team or Enterprise (organization). CPU Basic Spaces sleep after 48 hours without use. Only ports 80, 443 and 8080 are open for outbound requests.

rows.name: Koyeb Pro
rows.price_note: $29 per month plus compute.
rows.includes: $10 of included compute per month, 10 users, 100 services, NVMe volumes and snapshots, 5 concurrent builds, email and chat support.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Compute billed per second from $0.000006 per second; 100 GB outbound bandwidth free, then $0.04/GB.
rows.limits: Card required; a $29 pre-authorization hold is placed. Koyeb announced it is joining Mistral AI; the announcement says the free Starter plan will be removed and new users must subscribe to Pro, Scale or Enterprise with a valid payment method (https://www.koyeb.com/blog/koyeb-is-joining-mistral-ai-to-build-the-future-of-ai-infrastructure). The free web service listed in the pricing FAQ is therefore not open to new sign-ups.

rows.name: Northflank Sandbox
rows.price_note: Free tier, no card needed.
rows.includes: Up to $20 a month of resources on Northflank Cloud across 2 services, 2 jobs and 1 database; one bring-your-own-cloud cluster with up to 12 vCPU and 48 GB memory (your cloud provider bills that infrastructure). Always on, no sleeping.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Pay as you go from $0.01667 per vCPU hour, billed per second, no seat fees.
rows.limits: The page does not say what happens when the $20 of resources is used.

rows.name: Railway Free plan
rows.price_note: Free plan with $1 of usage credits each month, no credit card; new accounts also get a 30-day trial with a one-time $5 credit.
rows.includes: $1 of monthly usage credits, 1 project with up to 3 services, up to 1 vCPU and 0.5 GB RAM per service, 0.5 GB volume storage, one-click Postgres, Redis, MySQL and MongoDB.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Container usage: RAM $10/GB/month, CPU $20/vCPU/month, egress $0.05/GB, volume storage $0.15/GB/month; builds are free.
rows.limits: Services sleep after 5 to 10 minutes without outbound traffic and wake on the next request. The Free plan does not expire. When trial credits run out, running deployments are stopped. The page does not say what happens when the $1 is used.

rows.name: Railway Hobby
rows.price_note: $5 per month minimum, which includes $5 of usage.
rows.includes: $5 of monthly usage credits, up to 48 vCPU and 48 GB RAM per service, up to 5 replicas at 8 vCPU / 8 GB each, up to 5 GB storage, always-on services, 7-day log history, single developer workspace.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Usage above $5 billed at RAM $10/GB/month, CPU $20/vCPU/month, egress $0.05/GB, volume $0.15/GB/month.
rows.limits: The $5 fee is charged even if unused; included usage does not roll over. Railway may waive the fee for some active builders.

rows.name: Railway Pro
rows.price_note: $20 per month minimum, which includes $20 of usage.
rows.includes: $20 of monthly usage credits, up to 1,000 vCPU and 1 TB RAM per service, up to 42 replicas at 24 vCPU / 24 GB each, up to 1 TB storage, unlimited workspace seats.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Usage above $20 billed at the same per-resource rates as Hobby.
rows.limits: Included usage does not roll over.

rows.name: Render free instances
rows.price_note: Free compute plan for web services, Postgres and Key Value on the $0 Hobby workspace.
rows.includes: 750 free instance hours per workspace per month for free web services (512 MB RAM), one free Postgres database (1 GB, expires 30 days after creation), one free Key Value instance, free static sites; Hobby workspace includes 5 GB bandwidth and up to 25 services.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Paid instances start at $7/month (512 MB RAM, 0.5 CPU); SSD $0.25/GB per month.
rows.limits: Free web services spin down after 15 minutes without inbound traffic (about one minute to spin back up), have an ephemeral filesystem, and are suspended when the 750 hours are used. Bandwidth overage is billed if a payment method exists, otherwise services are suspended. Render says not to use free instances for production.

rows.name: Render paid web service, 512 MB
rows.price_note: $7 per month for the smallest paid instance, on the $0 Hobby workspace.
rows.includes: 512 MB RAM, 0.5 CPU (instance type 0.5c-512mb), always on, persistent disks available. Next size: 1 CPU, 2 GB RAM at $25 per month.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: SSD storage $0.25/GB per month. Pro workspace is $25 per month plus compute.
rows.limits: Hobby workspace: up to 25 services, 5 GB bandwidth included.

rows.name: Supabase Free plan
rows.price_note: $0 per month.
rows.includes: 2 active projects. Per project: 500 MB database, shared CPU with 500 MB RAM. 5 GB egress plus 5 GB cached egress, 1 GB file storage, 50,000 monthly active users, 500,000 Edge Function invocations, unlimited API requests.
rows.limits: Free projects pause after 1 week of inactivity. Paused projects do not count toward the 2-project limit, which applies across all organizations where you are Owner or Administrator. Egress, storage, MAU and Edge Function quotas apply to the whole organization, not per project; database size (500 MB) is per project. The pages read do not say what happens when a Free project goes over quota.

rows.name: Supabase Pro
rows.price_note: $25 per month per organization; first project included.
rows.includes: 100K monthly active users, 8 GB disk per project, 250 GB bandwidth, daily backups with 7-day retention, email support, $10 per month of compute credits (covers one Micro instance: 1 GB RAM, shared compute).
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Additional projects from $10 per month; custom domain $10 per month flat.
rows.limits: Spend cap is on by default, so usage beyond included quota is not billed until the cap is switched off.

rows.name: Vercel Hobby plan
rows.price_note: $0 per month.
rows.includes: Per month: 1M function invocations, 4 hours Fluid Active CPU, 360 GB-hrs provisioned memory, 1M CDN requests, 100 GB Fast Data Transfer, 10 GB Fast Origin Transfer, 5K image transformations.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: None: Hobby cannot buy extra usage; upgrade to Pro.
rows.limits: Terms of Service: the Hobby plan is for personal or non-commercial use only, and Vercel may disable or remove Hobby projects with or without notice. Past a Hobby usage limit you generally have to wait until 30 days have passed to use that feature again (Web Analytics collection resumes after 7 days). Hobby cannot buy extra usage.

rows.name: Vercel Pro
rows.price_note: $20 per month.
rows.includes: $20 of included usage credit, Flat Rate CDN with traffic spike protection, advanced spend management, team collaboration with free viewer seats, cold start prevention, free custom domain.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Usage beyond the credit is metered per resource as listed on the pricing page.
rows.limits: Free trial available.

rows.name: Zoho Catalyst free tier
rows.price_note: US$5 worth of free credits a month, forever. You pay only after you exceed them.
rows.includes: US$5 of free credits a month. The pricing calculator shows 25,000 GB-seconds of Functions, 900 GB-minutes of AppSail and 2,000 Circuits state transitions free. The FAQ says the tier covers more than 70 components, applied per account across all projects.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free within the tier; past it, usage bills at the pay-as-you-go rates (Functions US$0.000016 per GB-second, AppSail US$0.0013 per GB-minute).
rows.limits: If a project exceeds the free tier limits in an account, a minimum billing of US$5 applies. The page does not say whether a card is needed to use the free tier.

rows.name: Zoho Catalyst free trial
rows.price_note: US$250 of credits for 6 months. The page says to add a card to claim them.
rows.includes: US$250 in wallet credits. The trial lasts 6 months or until you use the US$250, whichever is earlier.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0 within the credits
rows.limits: Unused wallet credits expire after 6 months. Once the credits are used, invoicing starts from the next month for usage above them. Pay-as-you-go rates on the page include US$0.000016 per GB-second for Functions and US$0.0013 per GB-minute for AppSail. A paid subscription adds only US$5 a month of credits (the US$25 plan gives US$30), so it has no row here.

rows.name: Kiro Free
rows.includes: 50 credits/mo; Claude Sonnet 4.5 and open-weight models
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free
rows.limits: 50 credits per month, open-weight models and Claude Sonnet 4.5 'with limits'. Not available in Kiro Enterprise or AWS GovCloud (US). Use through third-party automation harnesses (e.g. OpenClaw) is not permitted. Content may be used for service improvement unless you opt out.

rows.name: Kiro Pro
rows.price_note: $20 per user per month, excluding tax. First upgrade from Free: the rest of that month is free plus 500 trial credits usable within 12 months (valid credit card required). Fees and credits are prorated to the second.
rows.includes: 1,000 credits/mo
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: 2x vs $0.04 add-on credits
rows.limits: Past plan credits you continue only by buying add-on credits ($0.04 each, packs from $5 for 125 credits to $100); add-on credits roll over and expire 12 months after purchase. Plan credits do not roll over. Third-party automation harnesses not permitted. GovCloud pricing about 20% higher.

rows.name: Claude Max
rows.price_note: $100 a month, billed monthly only (the pricing page lists no annual option for Max). Web price; mobile pricing may differ.
rows.includes: Everything in Pro, 5x Pro usage every 5 hours and every week, Claude Code, Fable up to half the weekly limit, and $100 a month in API credits for the Claude Platform (Claude API, Message Batches, Console Playground, Managed Agents, Agent SDK).
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: The $100 API credit spends at list API prices, so the plan returns its price in API credit plus the 5x Pro chat and Claude Code allowance (computed from the two pages).
rows.limits: 5-hour and weekly limits, plus a separate weekly Fable limit. API credits: claim after 7 days on the plan by linking one Console organization; they do not cover interactive Claude Code, extra usage, or Claude on Bedrock, Vertex AI or Foundry. Unused API credits expire at the end of each billing cycle. When they run out, API requests stop unless the organization holds bought credits.

rows.name: Claude Pro
rows.price_note: $20 billed monthly, or $17 a month with the annual plan ($200 billed up front). Prices exclude tax.
rows.includes: Claude Code, Claude Science, Claude in Chrome and Microsoft 365, Projects. Usage is at least 5x Free per 5-hour session, plus a weekly limit. Fable is available only through paid usage credits. No monthly API credits.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: No per-token price for plan usage. Optional usage credits past the limits are prepaid and billed at standard API rates.
rows.limits: A session limit that resets every 5 hours and a weekly limit. Claude Code shares the same limits as chat. Usage credits are opt-in and prepaid through Add funds; auto-reload is optional. Usage credits bought on or after December 7, 2026 expire 12 months after purchase (earlier purchases do not expire); purchases are non-refundable.

rows.name: Claude Team plan (standard and premium seats)
rows.price_note: Per standard seat: $25 billed monthly or $20 a month billed annually. Premium seat: $125 monthly or $100 a month billed annually. 2 to 150 seats; seat types can be mixed.
rows.includes: Claude Code and Cowork on both seat types, SSO, central billing, admin controls. Standard seats get 1.25x Pro per-session usage; premium seats get 6.25x (5x standard). Monthly API credits of $20 per standard seat and $100 per premium seat, pooled and capped at $500 a month.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: API credits spend at list API prices. Optional usage credits past seat limits bill at API rates.
rows.limits: Per-session and weekly limits per seat. API credits can be claimed once the Team plan is 7 days old, expire each billing cycle, and do not cover interactive Claude Code. The organization can enable usage credits for all seat types.

rows.name: Claude Ultra (formerly Max 20x)
rows.price_note: $200 a month, billed monthly only. Existing Max 20x subscribers moved to Ultra with no price change.
rows.includes: Everything in Max, 10x Pro usage every week, no 5-hour limit for verified accounts, Claude Code, Fable up to half the weekly limit, and $200 a month in API credits for the Claude Platform.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: The $200 API credit spends at list API prices, so the plan returns its price in API credit plus the 10x weekly Pro allowance (computed).
rows.limits: A weekly limit across all models and a separate weekly Fable limit. Unverified accounts get a temporary 5-hour limit until Anthropic verifies them from account and payment history. API credits follow the same rules as Max: they expire each billing cycle and do not cover interactive Claude Code or usage credits.

rows.name: Cerebras Code Pro
rows.price_note: Shown as 'sold out' on the Cerebras Code page on 2026-11-23 (the $200 Max tier is also sold out); the page invites visitors to follow for new plans.
rows.includes: Up to 24M tokens/day GLM 4.7
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: About $0.07 per million tokens if the full 24M tokens/day is used for 30 days (computed: $50 / 720M). No pay-as-you-go GLM price was readable on cerebras.ai/pricing today, so the 30x comparison could not be re-checked.
rows.limits: Sold out as of 2026-11-23. GLM 4.7 only, up to 24 million tokens per day; use with any editor or agent that accepts an API key.

rows.name: Cognee Cloud Standard
rows.price_note: $0 a month base, 100M tokens included, no card required.
rows.includes: 100M tokens, one workspace, unlimited users and API calls.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0.10 per 1M tokens past the included 100M.
rows.limits: Extra workspaces are $5 each per month. The page does not say how often the 100M tokens reset. The open-source engine can be self-hosted free.

rows.name: Devin (former Windsurf) Pro
rows.includes: Increased quotas (amounts unpublished) that refresh daily and weekly; frontier models from OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and SpaceXAI plus open-source models; free use of SWE-2; Devin Cloud agents; option to use your ChatGPT plan; up to 10 concurrent sessions.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Unquantified
rows.limits: Extra usage must be purchased and is consumed at API pricing. Up to 10 concurrent sessions.

rows.name: Firecrawl Free plan
rows.price_note: 1,000 free credits every month, no credit card required.
rows.includes: 1,000 credits a month, 2 concurrent requests and 2 concurrent browsers. /scrape, /map and /search allow 10 requests per minute; /crawl, /agent and /interact allow 2 per minute.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free. Paid plans start at Hobby $19 a month ($16 billed annually).
rows.limits: Pay-as-you-go is for paid plans only, not Free. The page does not say what happens when the Free credits run out.

rows.name: GitHub Copilot Free
rows.includes: 2,000 code completions per month; limited chat and agent usage (AI-credit allowance, models through auto model selection only); access to Haiku 4.5, GPT-5 mini and more; Copilot Fusion Standard.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free
rows.limits: Models only through auto model selection. Included allowance does not carry over between months.

rows.name: GitHub Copilot Max
rows.includes: 20,000 AI credits ($200: 10,000 base + 10,000 flex), everything in Pro+, priority access to new models and features, unlimited completions.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: 2.0x at API token rates
rows.limits: Allowance resets at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of each calendar month; unused credits are forfeited. The flex allotment is variable and 'may change over time'. When credits run out, usage stops unless you set an additional-usage budget (1 AI credit = $0.01) or upgrade. Code completions and next edit suggestions are unlimited and not billed in credits. Through Nov 30, 2026: 30% off model costs with Copilot Fusion; 10% off with auto model selection.

rows.name: GitHub Copilot Pro
rows.includes: 1,500 AI credits ($15: 1,000 base + 500 flex), unlimited completions
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: 1.5x at API token rates
rows.limits: Allowance resets at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of each calendar month; unused credits are forfeited. The flex allotment is variable and 'may change over time'. When credits run out, usage stops unless you set an additional-usage budget (1 AI credit = $0.01) or upgrade. Code completions and next edit suggestions are unlimited and not billed in credits. Through Nov 30, 2026: 30% off model costs with Copilot Fusion; 10% off with auto model selection.

rows.name: GitHub Copilot Pro+
rows.includes: 7,000 AI credits ($70: 3,900 base + 3,100 flex), premium models including Opus, third-party agents (Claude Code and Codex), Copilot Fusion Standard, High and Max, unlimited completions.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: 1.8x at API token rates
rows.limits: Allowance resets at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of each calendar month; unused credits are forfeited. The flex allotment is variable and 'may change over time'. When credits run out, usage stops unless you set an additional-usage budget (1 AI credit = $0.01) or upgrade. Code completions and next edit suggestions are unlimited and not billed in credits. Through Nov 30, 2026: 30% off model costs with Copilot Fusion; 10% off with auto model selection.

rows.name: Google Antigravity Individual
rows.includes: Baseline agent quota refreshed weekly; Antigravity app, CLI, IDE Extensions and Python SDK; parallel background agents, subagents, browser use and scheduled tasks. Models: Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6 (thinking), Claude Opus 4.6 (thinking), GPT-OSS-120b.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free
rows.limits: Deprecation: Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-OSS-120b 'will be removed on November 30, 2026', which leaves Gemini 3.8 Flash on the free plan. Rate limits vary by plan and task complexity.

rows.name: Ideogram Plus
rows.price_note: $20 billed monthly, or $15 a month billed yearly ($180). Prices exclude tax. No free trial for subscriptions.
rows.includes: 2,400 priority credits/mo
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: About $0.0083 per priority credit ($20 / 2,400) vs pay-as-you-go 1 cent per credit, about 1.2x (computed). The hosted API can use the subscription's monthly credits when they cover the whole request; otherwise it bills a prepaid API balance per image/second.
rows.limits: Unlimited slow-queue generations after priority credits run out; Editing with AI and Image Reference need priority credits. New images stay private until published. Payment by card through Stripe only.

rows.name: Krea Free
rows.includes: 100 compute units/day: ~30 Flux.1 Dev or 5 Flux 2 images
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Free

rows.name: Krea Pro
rows.price_note: $35 a month billed monthly (offer price in the page's structured data), or $21 a month billed yearly. On 2026-11-23 the page runs a limited-time sale with a countdown ('up to 75% off') and shows $42 as a struck-through reference price.
rows.includes: 20,000 compute units per month: about 6,000 Flux.1 Dev, 1,080 Flux 2, 592 LTX-2 19B (5 s, 512p) videos or 90 Wan 2.2 videos; all image and video models; LoRA training (50 images).

rows.limits: API access is billed separately from app plans; plan units do not cover the API. Compute top-up packs expire after 90 days.

rows.name: Magnific Plus
rows.price_note: $45 billed monthly, or $33.75 a month billed annually. Prices exclude VAT and local taxes. 30-day refund guarantee.
rows.includes: 600K credits per year on annual billing ('Credits valid for 1 year, no monthly resets'); Relax mode generations that save credits on 30+ models, with Nano Banana 2 and Kling 2.5 in Relax mode all year; image, video and audio models; commercial AI license plus music rights; API access with credit-based usage; 250M+ stock assets.
rows.limits: Relax mode replaces the earlier 'unlimited' wording. On annual billing, credits are valid for one year with no monthly resets; the page does not say how credits work on monthly billing. Top-ups available anytime.

rows.name: Meshy Free
rows.price_note: $0 a month, no credit card needed.
rows.includes: 100 credits a month, up to 10 assets, 1 concurrent task, low queue priority. Image to 3D, Text to 3D and AI Texturing in the web app. Assets under CC BY 4.0.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: No pay-as-you-go rate is published. API prices for comparison: Image to 3D with 2K or 4K textures 30 credits, rigging 5, animation 3 per action.
rows.limits: No API access. Through the CLI, the API or the MCP server a Free account can sign in, but creating tasks is refused with HTTP 402 plan_upgrade_required. Credits reset at 00:00 UTC on the first of each month. CC BY 4.0 asks for credit to Meshy.

rows.name: Meshy Pro
rows.price_note: $20 billed monthly. Premium is $40 billed monthly for 3,000 credits. Time-limited sales are in guides/detail/meshy.md.
rows.includes: 1,000 credits a month, API and MCP access, up to 100 assets, 10 concurrent tasks, 20 requests per second, high queue priority, customer-owned private assets. About 26 rigged characters with one animation each, at 38 credits apiece (Image to 3D with textures 30, rigging 5, one action 3; computed).
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: No pay-as-you-go rate is published, and extra credit pack prices are not on the page. On the plan a credit costs $0.02 ($20 / 1,000, computed), so one textured Image to 3D task (30 credits) costs about $0.60.
rows.limits: Plan credits reset monthly and do not accumulate. A request without enough credits gets HTTP 402. Extra credit packs are permanent credits that do not expire; the 40% pack discount is yearly only. API output is deleted three days after generation for non-Enterprise customers. Inputs and outputs may train Meshy's models unless opted out through support.

rows.name: Mistral Vibe Free (formerly Le Chat)
rows.price_note: Free plan.
rows.includes: Vibe on web and mobile, limited messages and web searches, limited coding sessions, basic image generation and editing, 100+ connectors.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Pro is $14.99 per month (excluding taxes).
rows.limits: Message and search limits are not quantified on the page (Pro offers up to 6x the messages and 5x the web searches of Free).

rows.name: Mistral Vibe Pro (formerly Le Chat Pro)
rows.price_note: $14.99 a month excluding tax. Verified students: $5.99 a month for up to 12 months. Subject to fair-usage limits and the Terms of Service.
rows.includes: Up to 6x Free messages and 5x web searches, all-day coding with Vibe in the CLI, IDE and web (Devstral), up to 40x Free image generations, up to 15 GB libraries, unlimited task scheduling, spreadsheets and slides. No monthly API credit is listed.
rows.limits: Subject to fair-usage limits. Past the plan limit you can extend usage with pay-as-you-go credits at API rates; the page does not say whether this is automatic.

rows.name: Perplexity Pro

rows.includes: Per the Pro plan card: expanded Computer access, 4,000 bonus credits, deep research, access to top AI models, model selection, polished documents and apps, and more usage limits and memory. A limited-time offer adds $40 of free Computer credits.

rows.name: Replit Core

rows.includes: $20 of monthly credits toward more powerful models, up to 30 hours of chat and up to 60 projects on Free Mode, unlimited workspaces, AI integrations, unlimited published apps.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Credits apply to Replit AI work, publishing, network transfer, database storage and AI Integrations; pay-as-you-go beyond credits.
rows.limits: Pricing page states prices are subject to tax.

rows.name: Replit Starter
rows.price_note: Free plan.

rows.resets: daily AI credits, monthly cloud credits
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Core is $20 per month ($18 billed annually).
rows.limits: Credit amounts are not stated on the page. The free published app goes down after 30 days and carries a Made with Replit badge. Full build, third-party connectors and Replit AI Integrations need Core.

rows.name: Venice Pro
